name: @arena/payments
description: Arena human-expert payments domain core (Work Order C010; issue #77; docs/LLM-ARCHITECT-FINAL-HANDOFF.md §8 commercial model). Money primitives (string-scaled minor units — never floats), the append-only escrow/hold ledger with a guarded commercial state machine (HOLD → offer/acceptance → CAPTURE → RELEASE → REFUND), versioned deterministic platform-fee/expert-payout splits, idempotent correlation-addressable money operations, tamper-evident digest-chained entries, commercial audit events, the provider-neutral PaymentProvider port and the demo/customer truth-label law. Provider settlement, merchant-of-record, tax and jurisdiction responsibilities stay behind adapters (architecture-lock rule 33).
